author: CNN
description:
President Trump told CNBC that he spoke with Nvidia’s board directly about reinstating CEO Jensen Huang. And he said he assured them there’s no evidence Huang is a national security risk — at least based on what is currently known. Both are extraordinary interventions from the president in the inner workings of an American company. Trump called his actions “very important.”

But financial disclosures show that Trump's investment accounts have bought or sold Nvidia shares at least 103 times between January 2025 and August 2026, meaning that he has likely benefited personally from Nvidia's stock soaring since the board announced that it had reinstated Huang.

description:
President Donald Trump said he believes Huang did “nothing wrong” and spoke directly with the Nvidia board about reinstating him. Trump insisted to advisers and officials that Huang needed to return to help steady the market, a source told CNN. The president’s portfolio has millions invested in Nvidia stock, but the White House has consistently denied that Trump has any influence over his investment accounts.
